findings.summary: The Fish template loops over newline-split output, but format_completion now emits three newline-separated lines per completion (type, value, help). Each iteration therefore sees one line, so metadata indexes are unset or out of range and Fish completion breaks.

judge.reason: Describes newline-separated fields being split per-line by the Fish loop, breaking metadata indexing.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: Newlines are escaped as a literal backslash-n, and nothing in the Fish script reverses this. Descriptions show literal \n text and values containing newlines are altered.

judge.reason: Escaped newline as literal \n is never unescaped in fish script; plausible real defect distinct from the key bug.

findings.label: valid_other

findings.summary: The "_" sentinel for "no help" is overloaded. An option whose real help text is exactly "_" loses its description, and the template's `!= "_"` check at line 190 has the same problem.

judge.reason: The '_' sentinel collides with real help text of '_'; real though minor edge-case defect.

findings.label: valid_other

findings.summary: The `.. versionchanged:: 8.3` note should say 8.4, since CHANGES.rst lists this change as Unreleased after 8.3.3.

judge.reason: Documentation version note nit, not a behavioral defect.

findings.label: false_alarm

findings.summary: The new CHANGES.rst entry has no :pr: reference.

judge.reason: Missing :pr: reference in changelog is style, not a defect.

findings.label: false_alarm
